hook_text: One school concert in George uses every number skill from the whole year. Can you spot them all?
clip_script: Concert night in George. Ticket money R136 480: the 3 is worth 30 000, rounded it is R136 000. Friday 1 245 plus Saturday 1 878: 3 123 people. 48 rows of 26 chairs: 1 248. Stacked in 24s: 52 stacks. 750 programmes in bundles of 40: 18 full, so 19 to tie them all. 3/8 of 48 rows for parents: 18 rows. Ticket rule: times 35, plus 5. 4 tickets: R145. Estimate first, check with the opposite.
visual_style: A concert hall filling with chairs and people, each number skill appearing as a label above the crowd.
mood: Joyful and proud, like the last big event of the school year.
pacing: Rapid tour from the ticket desk to the hall to the price board, one skill per beat.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and do one practice question from every number topic.
